cl.c: Data sheet pages 1-2: Product Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: The effect of Sika Retarder® N depends on a number of factors such as cement type, ambient temperature and mix design. The optimum dosage should be determined by site or laboratory tests with the particular concrete mix design. The rate of addition is generally in the range of: 200ml ± 100ml per 100kg of cementitious materials. Note: For dose rates higher than 400 ml/100kg please refer to your Sika representative.

Increase in dosage rate will cause an increase in the setting time. If this occurs, do not change to an accelerator. A severe overdose may delay the setting time of the concrete to detrimental extent.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
